title: Filtered products and boundary-preserving compression in complex cobordism

issues.description: Everything hinges on a cited black box: that MU_(p)/BP-Adams filtration has a sublinear vanishing curve that is uniform over all connective p-local spectra, stated here as nullity of I_R^{∧n}∧τ_{<k}S_(p) → τ_{<k}S_(p) for n ≥ f(k) = o(k). The cited sources (Mathew 2018 §3.4; Burklund–Hahn–Senger App. B) were not checked line by line. The reformulation and how it is used are internally correct.
issues.evidence: Proof of Thm 1.1 uses n_ℓ ≥ f(k_ℓ) with k_ℓ=(e−d)ℓ+1 and Lemma 2.5 (cell bound D_ℓ<k_ℓ). Both steps are valid given the cited statement.

coverage:
Read all five sections in full. Checked these steps:
- Simplex-slicing lemma: naturality in Δ and the count of at most j non-vertices.
- Compatible Adams lift (Prop 2.1): Yoneda / left-Kan-extension vertex nullhomotopy, collapse on U∧Δ^j for j<n, restriction to the punctured unit cube via S↦[|S|−1], and total fiber = I_R^{∧n}.
- Proof of Thm 1.1: prime-by-prime vanishing via the truncation detection lemma, the large-prime BP connectivity 2p−3 (H_*(BP;F_p) first positive degree 2p−2, Nakayama/Hurewicz), and the local-to-global argument.
- Point-test products and local duality: single-plane degree ±1, the excision identities U_ε(L_J)∩U_ε(L_K)=U_ε(L_{J∪K}), and naturality.
- Stable avoidance: box-control constants (radius 2c–3c gives distance >c and displacement <4c), and the Freudenthal connectivity versus dim σ ≤ 2q−5 lifting.
- Boundary restoration: sign preservation when |f_ji|>3/4 and |g−f|<1/2.
- Batch vanishing counting: fewer than ℓ/4 bad groups.
- Padding arithmetic: covering by A_j/B_j, dist ≥1 on A_j, q_j>7/8 D_j, dim W_j<3/2 D_j via tb(B+1) ≥ 2ℓd_P, D_j ≥ 20, and the fraction ≥ a/8 for j ≥ 2B.
- MU torus criterion: MU^4(T^2)=0 gives x_i^2=0, the inverse Chern series, top coefficient vanishing by rank K−r<r, Thom class and excision to the point-test pair.
- Stone–Weierstrass finite-parameter reduction with the bad-set compactness.
- Sharpness example at K=2pn: degree argument on ∂B.
main_claim: Thm 1.1: if v|_G is MU-null, then v^{∧ℓ} is stably null on the union U_ℓ of products with at least ⌈ℓ/2⌉ factors in G, for large ℓ. Thm 1.2: if the slot bundle over the torus locus embeds into a trivial bundle of rank K<2pn, then for arbitrarily large u there is G: Y^u → C(2p+1,un) with at least (a/8)un boundary slots that preserves original boundary slots exactly.
